name: Modules.Map.ImageOverlay
summary: Represents a bounded area on the map that has an image overlay.
description:
The `ImageOverlay` object gives you low-level control over image overlays that can be added to a
[map view](api:Modules.Map.View). An image overlay must have a `boundsCoordinate` property and a `image` 
set to appear on a map.

Use the [Modules.Map.createImageOverlay](api:Modules.Map#createImageOverlay) method to create an image overlay.

properties.name: boundsCoordinate
properties.summary: An object representing diagonal coordinates (`topLeft` and `bottomRight`) on the map.

inlined.name: MapBoundsCoordinateType
inlined.summary: An object representing the bound coordinates on the map.

properties.name: bottomRight
properties.summary: An object with longitude and latitude values.

properties.name: topLeft
properties.summary: An object with longitude and latitude values.

properties.name: image
properties.summary: The image that is shown as an overlay on the map.
